observation_kind: targeted current official schema, endpoint, format and coverage-metadata checks; not independent bulk HTTP fetches
rules: The Shape field is mandatory geometry and each index polygon must be a single area.
Poly_ID is a mandatory numeric unique polygon reference managed through dataset lifecycle rules.
Title_No is a mandatory character identifier for a registered title.
INSERT is a mandatory date recording initial creation on the index map.
UPDATE is a mandatory date recording the last update to all or part of the title.
Vers_No is a mandatory numeric version for Poly_ID.
Rec_Status is a mandatory character field describing polygon status.
Record status values are Added, Changed or Deleted, represented as A, C or D.
Overlaps may be acceptable for different floor levels, strata, tenures or classes of title.
Actual title overlaps are resolved when an application is made.
Overlaps below 0.5 square metres are not referred to caseworkers for remedial action.
Change-only delivery contains only the latest version after multiple polygon changes.
Previous polygon versions are not retained in the published delivery.
NPD files are updated and available from the second working day of each month.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield INSPIRE GML hrefs, bytes and hashes remain unavailable because the official download view redirects.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG polygon containment for the three candidates remain unresolved.
Multiple dataset parameters can be supplied in one entity query.
For registered properties, a UPRN passed through q is described as more precise than a coordinate query.
An empty result must not be treated as proof that no constraints exist because coverage varies by area.
For large portfolios, bulk downloads and local spatial intersections avoid rate limits and provide a stable snapshot.
Bulk downloads are available as CSV, JSON and, where applicable, GeoJSON and Parquet.
Parquet is identified as well suited to large datasets.
The Planning Data API is in beta and may change for production integrations.
The field parameter takes precedence over fields listed in exclude_field.
One entity can be retrieved through /entity/{entity}.{extension}.
The published OpenAPI document can be used to generate a client library.
